map.Q = m·c·ΔT；水的比热容约 4186 J/(kg·K)。 1 kg 水升: Q = m·c·ΔT; the specific heat of water is about 4186 J/(kg·K). Heating 1 kg of water by 10 °C takes 41.86 kJ.
map.物体升温所需热量等于质量 × 比热容 × 温升。: The heat needed to warm an object equals mass × specific heat × temperature rise.
map.物体升温/降温显热 Q=mcΔT。: Sensible heat for heating or cooling an object Q=mcΔT.
map.与潜热叠加得总热。: Add the latent heat to get the total heat.
